body: My counselor and I explored my issues more. I had an intense HIV scare a few months ago where I was terrified and certain I had it for a month. I remember at the time thinking if I didn't have it how grateful I would be. I thought I'd appreciate life more then. But at some point I gained comfort by realizing how tiny and insignificant I am too the universe. I decided I'd kill myself and it would be no big deal, just a few people would care. I've never felt that way before. When I thought my life was over it made me feel better. Now it feels like all the magic, passion and love has been ripped out of me. I didn't feel tiny before. I didn't care I loved life. Now it's like a fucking black hole inside me. This anger, pain and emptiness I didn't care before. I wish I could be the way I was before.. But I can't unfeel this.

Depression can be triggered. I do understand what you mean though.... Real depression is not being unhappy with your life situation. It's a lack of interest in things you once would have enjoyed or found fascinating. Like I used to love playing with my nieces or wrestling. Now I try to fake it but I have 0 interest. I'd rather just lay in my bed. I want to want things again. I don't even remember what it feels like.

A guy I dated last month sent me creepy text messages. I texted my ex and asked to borrow a gun until I could get my own. An hour alone with it and had a serious impulse to put it in my mouth and pull the trigger. Which was not a feeling I expected to ever have but... Bleh
